CreateGpt.page_subtitle: Configure the agent's role, model, behavior, and knowledge for consistent task execution.
CreateGpt.identity_description: Use a clear name and description to explain what this agent does best.

CreateGpt.capability_group_knowledge_description: The agent can inspect and read the knowledge files attached to this agent and reference them on demand.
CreateGpt.capability_attachment_list_description: View which files were uploaded in the current chat and inspect their basic metadata.

CreateGpt.capability_knowledge_list_description: View which knowledge files are currently attached to this agent.

CreateGpt.visible_models_description: Controls which models this agent actually exposes to users.
CreateGpt.upload_types_description: Controls which attachment types users may upload in this agent chat. Native image support remains a model capability.
CreateGpt.knowledge_description: The agent reads these files on demand

CreateGpt.permission_owner_create_hint: A newly created agent belongs to the current account by default, and ownership can be transferred later from the edit page.

Admin.page_subtitle: Review and maintain model capabilities, permission assignments, and feature flags in one place. This version focuses on the core business configuration domains needed before production rollout.
Admin.sections_subtitle: Jump directly to models, permissions, feature flags, and audit.

Admin.gpts_subtitle: Manage agent and library entry state, visibility scope, and compatibility notes in one place.
